steps.command:
pwd
ls -la
file a.out 2>/dev/null || true
ls -la /workspace

cat hi.c
echo '--- run ---'
./a.out; echo exit:$?
echo '--- readelf -h ---'
readelf -h a.out
echo '--- sections ---'
readelf -SW a.out
echo '--- symbols ---'
readelf -sW a.out | head -100
echo '--- strings ---'
strings -a -t x a.out | head -100

find / -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -iname '*extract*' -o -iname '*reference*' -o -iname '*test*' -o -iname '*.json' -o -iname 'README*' \) 2>/dev/null | head -100
echo '--- root ---'
ls -la /
echo '--- workspace all ---'
find /workspace -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%p %s\n'
echo '--- lost+found ---'
ls -la /workspace/lost+found | head
echo '--- env ---'
env | sort | head -100

find /opt /tmp /home /root /run /var -maxdepth 4 -type f -printf '%p %s\n' 2>/dev/null | head -200
echo '--- installed tools ---'
which gcc objdump readelf nm gdb python3 node qemu-x86_64 valgrind strace ltrace 2>/dev/null
node --version 2>/dev/null || true
echo '--- ls /opt ---'
find /opt -maxdepth 3 -printf '%M %p\n' 2>/dev/null | head -100

readelf -lW a.out
echo '--- dump bytes ---'
readelf -x .rodata a.out
readelf -x .data a.out
readelf -x .text a.out | head -20
echo '--- hexdump start ---'
xxd -g4 -l 128 a.out

cat /tmp/guest-agent/ga-cmd-5 2>/dev/null || true
find /tmp/guest-agent -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%p %s\n' 2>/dev/null
echo '--- proc cmdline ---'
tr '\0' ' ' </proc/1/cmdline; echo
echo '--- mounts ---'
cat /proc/mounts | head -50
echo '--- /work? ---'
ls -la /work 2>/dev/null || true

python3 - <<'PY'
data=open('a.out','rb').read()
for h in ['697e616a','685f6c66']:
 b=bytes.fromhex(h)
 print(h, data.find(b))
PY

grep -rIl --exclude='*.so*' --exclude='*.a' --exclude='*.o' -e 'extract\.js' -e 'reference solution' -e 'memory values' /usr/local /etc /opt /root /home /var /run /tmp 2>/dev/null | head -50
echo '--- all files /opt /usr/local top ---'
find /usr/local -maxdepth 3 -type f -printf '%p %s\n' 2>/dev/null | head -100
echo '--- agent ---'
file /usr/local/bin/agent 2>/dev/null
ls -la /usr/local/bin

rg -l --hidden --no-messages -g '!proc/**' -g '!sys/**' -g '!dev/**' -g '!workspace/lost+found/**' -g '!usr/lib/**' -g '!usr/share/**' -e 'out\.json' -e 'reference solution' -e 'at least 75%' -e 'memory values' / 2>/dev/null | head -100

which debugfs dumpe2fs e2ls 2>/dev/null || true
ls -la /dev/vd* 2>/dev/null || true
cat /proc/partitions
mount | head
find /workspace -maxdepth 2 -printf '%M %s %p\n'
getfattr -d /workspace/a.out 2>/dev/null || true
stat /workspace/a.out /workspace/hi.c /opt/testbed-src/a.out

debugfs -R 'lsdel' /dev/vdb 2>/dev/null | head -100
echo '--- rootdir ---'
debugfs -R 'ls -l /' /dev/vdb 2>/dev/null
echo '--- lostfound ---'
debugfs -R 'ls -l /lost+found' /dev/vdb 2>/dev/null
debugfs -R 'lsdel' /dev/vda 2>/dev/null | head -200

find / -xdev -type f \( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.py' -o -name '*.sh' -o -name '*.json' -o -name '*.yaml' -o -name '*.yml' -o -name '*.toml' -o -name '*.md' -o -name '*.txt' \) -printf '%p %s\n' 2>/dev/null | sort | head -300

mkdir -p /tmp/t && cd /tmp/t
cp /workspace/hi.c .
for flags in "" "-no-pie" "-no-pie -N" "-no-pie -Wl,-Ttext=0x400000" "-pie -Wl,-Ttext-segment=0x400000"; do
  echo "=== gcc $flags ==="
  gcc $flags hi.c -o x 2>/tmp/e || { cat /tmp/e; continue; }
  readelf -SW x | awk '/\.interp|\.text|\.rodata|\.data|\.bss/ {print $2,$4,$6}'
  readelf -lW x | awk '/LOAD/ {print $2,$3,$5,$6,$7}'
done

cd /tmp
pip download --no-deps terminal-bench==0.2.18 -d tb 2>&1 | tail -20
find tb -type f -maxdepth 2 -printf '%p %s\n'
